questions.question: The pre-tool hook does not govern or claim file-tool writes into a sibling worktree (it resolves the repo root from the session cwd, not the target path). Because of that the degraded window closed with 0 files and stage done refuses. How do you want this handled?
options: Hotfix the hook + re-apply the fixes under two windows (Recommended)
Hotfix the hook only; accept a stage-close exception for T1
Stop here; you take it to symphony-forge first
questions.chosen: Hotfix the hook + re-apply the fixes under two windows (Recommended)
